title: A plugin manifest
description:
Read a plugin's description file and check it before loading anything.

```
name = Fire Spells
id = fire.spells
version = 1.2.0
needs host = 2.0
entry = fire.dll
-> ok
missing "entry" -> refused
```
hints: Wrap the text in a `std::istringstream` and read it with `std::getline(stream, line)`, one line at a time. Split each line at `line.find('=')` with `substr`, then trim spaces from both ends of each part: a small loop that removes `' '` from the front and the back while there is one does it.
Collect problems in a `std::vector<std::string>`; the manifest is accepted only when it is empty.
requirements: Parse `key = value` lines, ignoring blank lines and `#` comments.
Require `id`, `version` and `entry`; `id` uses only lower-case letters, digits and dots.
Report every problem, not just the first.
stretch: Read the manifest from JSON instead. That needs a JSON library; look up the header-only `nlohmann/json` (lesson 4.05 mentions it) and its `json::parse`.
